description: XFCN PM254V-11-08-H85 single-row vertical female header
name: xfcn-pm254v-11-08-h85

provenance.source: manual from XFCN drawing PM254V-11-XX-H85 rev A1; supplier nominal body model

watch_out_for: Manufacturer recommended 1.02 mm holes and 2.54 mm pitch; library zero-angle and body-centered origin match exact supplier CAD, pin 1 left. Drawing labels 1 and 2; remaining sequential contact labels are the supplier/library convention. Raw supplier STEP was translated (0,-1.25,+4.25) mm to its matching WRL frame; no scaling or replacement geometry. Nominal supplier body is not a maximum-tolerance assembly guarantee. 3D source: JLCEDA/EasyEDA Official Library, https://lceda.cn/ and https://easyeda.com/, product C46595973.
